#!/bin/bash

# Find all symbolic links in /tmp/mcp-workspace/workspace and check if they're broken
broken_links=()

# Use find to locate all symbolic links
while IFS= read -r link; do
    # Check if the symlink target exists
    if ! test -e "$link" 2>/dev/null; then
        broken_links+=("$link")
    fi
done < <(find /tmp/mcp-workspace/workspace -type l 2>/dev/null)

# Write results to file
output_file="/tmp/mcp-workspace/workspace/broken_links.txt"
> "$output_file"  # Clear the file

if [ ${#broken_links[@]} -eq 0 ]; then
    echo "No broken symbolic links found"
else
    for link in "${broken_links[@]}"; do
        echo "$link" >> "$output_file"
    done
    echo "Found ${#broken_links[@]} broken symbolic links"
fi

cat "$output_file"
